background: Bank of America Corporation is the holding company of the second-largest US bank, spanning consumer banking, wealth management under Merrill and a global corporate and investment bank.
synthesis: Bank of America is rated A+ on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A-, all three on a stable outlook, the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 3 May 2023. The rating is the strength; the balance sheet sits on the weak side of US banks, with CET1 of 11.2% in the bottom quarter and leverage of 5.5% and LCR of 112% both below the peer median. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods (figures to 30 Jun 2026). The newest flagged item, on 1 Oct 2026, is a $39 million class action settlement, small for a group of this size, with an 8% fall in the shares in a week before it.
